composition: central helicopter on dense target field
description: Layered collage of aircraft technical diagrams, concentric target rings, vinyl record discs, and bold pink and yellow planes of color across a predominantly white ground. Recurring bullseye motifs in red, black, and cyan overlap drawn warplane silhouettes, a chess-piece profile, gridded schematics, and typographic fragments throughout the densely packed vertical composition.
title: Untitled (Helicopter on Targets)
